description:
Blue Sky Plan 5 is open on the Windows desktop. A real anonymized dental CBCT scan in DICOM format is available at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DentalDICOM.

A patient needs a single dental implant in the lower right posterior jaw. Prepare a complete, presentation-ready treatment plan that demonstrates safe implant placement with adequate nerve clearance. The plan should include appropriate panoramic curve alignment, a properly sized and positioned implant, and verification that the implant does not encroach on the inferior alveolar nerve.

Save the treatment plan to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\BlueSkyPlanTasks\complete_plan.bsp. Export a screenshot of the final plan to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\BlueSkyPlanTasks\complete_plan_screenshot.png.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
